scope: Complete unflip, temporary damage protection and relocation helpers; no whole-mod parity

findings.disposition: Useful intent: persistent immobilization, crew history and nearby collision awareness. Reject automatic transform/velocity correction as natural WAIT driving. Source loop lacks route/task/Zeus receipts; local vehicle alone does not authorize crew orders.

findings.evidence: Remembers alive nonplayer crew seat/turret rows while aboard. After repair, eligible on-foot former crew within150m receive seat assignments/orderGetIn. At45s, unseen former crew can be moveIn seated; queue expires120s. Delayed phase only retains alive/on-foot/age and visibility checks, not newer tasks, assignment, group ownership, consciousness or local actor.
findings.disposition: Retain original-seat intent and finite return deadline. A WAIT implementation requires owner-local native boarding, unchanged assignment/task receipts, reserved incoming-seat arbitration and migration handling. Reject forced seating and stale crew recall; corpse/vacancy and partial crew recovery need physical cases.

findings.evidence: protectBriefly snapshots vehicle+crew permissions, allowDamage false, then spawned delayed callback enables damage for each originally allowed object. No token, local-owner check, current-state receipt or overlap count; it does not restore false values explicitly.
findings.disposition: Overlapping calls can let an older timer end a newer protection window; later mission protection can also be overwritten. Do not copy. Any authorized temporary protection needs finite owner-local restoration with explicit overlap/ownership design; matching false alone cannot identify a newer false write.

findings.evidence: Helper rejects ships and airborne aircraft>5m; searches roads100m (not pedestrian/bridge/trail/hide), then up to180 radial ground candidates through150m. Includes wrecks, props, people, terrain categories and nearby moving traffic; road heading follows closest original orientation.
findings.disposition: Collision-aware placement and bounded candidate intent can inform explicit placement tasks, not physical pathfinding success. Road branch does not apply full terrain/flatness predicate used for radial ground spots. No swept route/3D hull clearance proof or predictive arrival safety.

findings.evidence: Chosen relocation spot reserves15m for30s in local missionNamespace. Transform is written unscheduled after checks and temporary protection. Helper itself has no local vehicle, curator/order receipt or requester guard.
findings.disposition: No cross-owner atomic reservation. Reject using this local list as shared multiplayer coordination. Natural recovery must keep authored route and physical travel; explicit operator placement is a separate task.

findings.evidence: Production search found allowDamage temporary restoration in CortexParachuteJump: original permission is restored by raw allowDamage remoteExecCall after0.8s abort or subsequent3s callback. No per-exit damage-protection token or overlap journal in that function.
